description: Speech-to-text for an uploaded video or audio file: returns timestamped SRT (the timeline to rewrite, translate or re-voice with srt_to_speech). Credits are charged per second of media, measured by the server. Use language = the spoken language code from list_languages.

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. vi, en, ja.

media_url.description: public_url from create_upload_url (or a ttsforfree CDN link).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds the server waits for the audio before returning. If the job is still PENDING, call get_job_status later with the returned job_id.

name: transcribe_media
title: Transcribe video/audio to SRT
